The '''Corellian Run Scoundrels''' was a [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggling]] gang operating on the [[Corellian Run/Legends|Corellian Run]] during the [[Galactic War]]. A notorious Corellian Run Scoundrels [[Captain/Legends|captain]] [[Kai Zykken]] operated from [[Raider's Cove]] on [[Rishi/Legends|Rishi]], along with his first mate [[Tomota]].<ref name="SWTOR" /> [[Lana Beniko]] held a low opinion of them, saying she'd rather the galaxy fall to the [[Eternal Empire]] than recruit the gang.

==Behind the scenes==
Corellian Run Scoundrels first appeared in the ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Shadow of Revan]]'' expansion, released on [[December 2]], [[2014]].
